facts.fact: 宣布日：NYU 转学、Brooklyn 公寓、11 天后走——走了就不回来（Eloise 亲口说过）。
facts.anchor: Eloise would never let me move back in.

facts.fact: 告知父母搬家：Eloise 一句「你干过最蠢的事」开火——她的手开始抖。
facts.anchor: this is the most ridiculous of all.

facts.fact: Eloise 的失败预言：好消息是我终于要走了——顺便提醒你，你注定失败。
facts.anchor: I’m just preparing you for the fact that you’re going to fail.

facts.fact: 骂战升级：Eloise 后悔嫁给父亲、骂她 spoiled piece of shit。
facts.anchor: I never would’ve married your dad if I knew what I was getting into with you

facts.fact: 掌掴落地——她忍住不还手：「这是唯一能赢的方式，我不屑于跟她一样低。」
facts.anchor: I feel her hand forcefully come across my face.

facts.fact: 她捂着脸微笑：Happy now?——Eloise 第一次愣住。
facts.anchor: “Happy now?” I ask, my voice shaking through my smirk.

facts.fact: 父亲全程通红沉默、没有保护她——You aren’t going to do anything?! Figures.
facts.anchor: His face has turned beet red, but of course, he’s not saying anything.

facts.fact: 收拾行装（薰衣草色行李袋）投奔 Maggie：她让我恨自己、而且是故意的——我值不止这些。
facts.anchor: I know now more than ever, that I’m worth more than that.

facts.fact: 父亲迟来的道歉换来她的控诉：我天天在你眼前，你怎么看不见我碎了？
facts.anchor: How could you not see that I was broken?

facts.fact: 父亲的临别请求竟是「别告诉别人」——她甩下「你跟她一样坏」，拖着包走出家门。
facts.anchor: That’s what you have to say to me? You’re just as bad as she is.
